checks.name: Integer-cent product amount and unknown final fees remain distinct
Express fee is applied once per selection rather than per item
Empty decimal exponent signed padded and out-of-range quantities are rejected
Unknown availability is preserved rather than coerced into zero
Sold out and insufficient stock return different recovery reasons
Invalid options and nonboolean express values cannot yield a quote
Malformed prices duplicate identifiers missing stock and unsafe styles fail data parsing
Parsing does not retain a mutable caller-owned data object
Aborted local quote rejects without returning a stale selection
A rejected local request can retry with the same input
Changed preview price is recorded in a fresh quote
Unsafe amount formatting and negative resulting prices are rejected

limitations: Original local fictional model, not source billing or live inventory validation
